profile.headline: Sr. Staff Software Engineer at Cribl
profile.summary:
Senior Software Engineer/Engineering Manager with experience in SaaS and TCP/IP network software.

Specialties: TCP/IP, C/C++, VPNs, firewalls, load balancers, packet analysis

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Responsible for delivery of new features for the Datadog Agent for Windows
- Created Windows monitoring package for new security product.
- Created NPM driver, a Windows WFP driver for collecting network traffic statistics, and protocol analysis
- Created process driver.
- Created full CI/CD pipeline for Datadog Windows product delivery
- Created new integrations for monitoring Windows Active Directory, IIS, SQL Server, and others
- Created original Windows process agent, the component which enables the Datadog process products
- Created original Windows logs agent, which enables the logs product.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Sole engineer for Bitglass’ Endpoint Agent  
- Development lead/designer for Windows, OSX, and cross-platform code.
- Implemented client/server REST API  in C++ for Mac and Windows agent
- Ported API to Java
- Created Windows installer using WIX (Windows MSI)
- Created Mac installer using PackageBuilder
- Prototyped multiple possibilities for Android
- Ported proxy server implementation to Java

positions.title: MTS
positions.description:
•	Lead engineer for Pertino Connect, the software agent for Pertino Networks Software as a Service (SaaS) VPN in-the-cloud product.  
o	Development lead/designer for Windows and cross-platform code.
o	Developed and maintained interface between the client and cloud-based policy server
o	Developed and delivered Mac OS/X and Linux versions
o	Converted installer from InnoSetup to WIX (Windows MSI)

positions.title: Lead engineer
positions.description:
Juniper Networks' all-in-one client for NAC, SSL-VPN, traditional VPN access, and WAN acceleration.  Led the product from concept to completion of unifying what was previously a fractured collection of disparate applications.
Designed component-based architecture, allowing for individual capabilities to be developed, installed, upgraded, and maintained separately.
Delivered components necessary for client integration with NAC product (UAC) and IPSec remote access (SRX).
Provided technical direction and support for client integration with the SSL-VPN and WAN acceleration products.
Delivered JAM (Juniper Access Manager, the previous name for Pulse) 1.0, 1.1, 1.2 and Pulse 1.0 and 2.0.
Lead engineer for Odyssey Access Client, which integrated the existing 802.1x functionality of OAC with the existing NAC access capabilities of the UAC client.
Created a COM interface and implementation that provides the UAC product features to the OAC product.
Responsible for client side IPSec integration and client side firewall integration.
Implemented all of the development integration, including build system integration, and source code migration from ClearCase to Perforce.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Responsible for design, implementation, and support of the TCP/IP stack and supporting libraries for the PalmOne family of portable devices, including the Treo Smartphone and Tungsten line of PDAs.
Managed the release of the WiFi add-on card for the Tungsten E/2.

positions.title: Founder, Engineering Lead, Engineering Manager
positions.description:
Managed and contributed to the design, development, delivery and support of the following products:
Aventail Connect VPN 1.0 - 4.0
Aventail.NET Managed Service CPE Platform version 2.0
Aventail Load Balancer 1.0
High availability and load balancing for the Aventail EX-1500 SSL VPN appliance
Managed the client team and the client software product, Aventail Connect.  Directed the product through the transformation from hooking technology to layered service provider to Windows TDI shim.
Led client team transition from software product provider to managed service business model.
Managed development team which created the Aventail.NET CPE version 2.0.  This hardware/software combination is the key to the Aventail.NET service, which boasts over 75,000 users.
Managed team which created the Aventail Load Balancers.  The system design was used for Aventail's flagship SSL VPN appliances, the EX-750 and EX-1500.
Managed platform team, which created the base system for the EX-750 and EX-1500 appliance.  This team was also the lead team in the transition from developing the managed service to developing an enterprise class product.
Developed and maintained the RPC implementation for the FTP Software SDK for DOS, Windows, and OS/2.

positions.title: Lead Engineer
positions.description:
Designed and delivered general purpose Winsock 'hooking' technology for Win16 and Win32.
Delivered all Stardust contract development services
Designed test facility for WinSock interoperability testing.
Designed facility for operating system replication to multiple machines.

positions.title: Senior Engineer
positions.description:
Delivered NetShield NLM for NetWare.  Was lead engineer for two other engineers.  
Implemented source control system.

positions.title: Member of Technical Staff
positions.description:
Contributed to the Windows Sockets working group.
Designed and implemented the second generation network driver for the Windows Network Driver interface.  
Implemented new user interface and device driver control.
Co-designed and implemented the NFS print server for Windows.  
Integrated software with Windows Print Manager.
Maintained Windows Sockets implementation.
Developed and maintained the RPC implementation for the FTP Software SDK for DOS, Windows, and OS/2.
